confirm_risks.title: Heating circuit {circuit}: please read before turning this on
confirm_risks.description:
The room temperature then directly affects how the heat pump controls this heating circuit:

- A room temperature below the setpoint raises the flow temperature, a few kelvin can be enough to reach the maximum flow temperature.
- A room temperature above the setpoint can switch the heating circuit off.
- If the entity has no usable value for 5 minutes (unavailable, outside 5–40 °C, or no report for 2 hours), the room setpoint is sent instead, so the room temperature has no effect until the entity is usable again.
- If Home Assistant itself is down, the controller keeps working with the last value it received.
- How strongly the controller reacts depends on the parameter "Room temperature compensation" (03-007) on the operating module. For underfloor heating, Hoval recommends no more than 4.

Close this dialog to change nothing.

data.accept_risks: I have read these notes and want to continue

experimental.title: Experimental functions
experimental.description: These functions are still being tested on few installations. They can make the heat pump run less efficiently or the rooms get too cold or too warm, so keep an eye on them after turning one on. Some of them are then set up in a heating circuit's form.

data_description.experimental_cooling: Enables cooling for heating circuits whose control strategy includes it. Only turn on if the installation can cool.
data_description.experimental_room_influence: Lets you switch room influence on or off per heating circuit and send a room temperature from Home Assistant to the controller.
data_description.experimental_flow_setpoint_raise: Lets you raise the heat pump's flow temperature above the heating circuit's, for heating circuit 1 with a suggestion and automatic adjustment.
data_description.experimental_constant_control: Controls heating circuits on constant control through a heating / off / cooling select and fixed flow temperatures.

confirm_cooling_off.title: Turn cooling off
confirm_cooling_off.description:
Heating circuit(s) {circuits} currently cool. Saving turns their cooling off and checks it; only then is it saved.

Close this dialog to change nothing.

confirm_room_influence_off.title: Turn room influence off
confirm_room_influence_off.description:
For heating circuit(s) {circuits}, the control strategy is set back to its value from before room influence and checked; only then is it saved.

Close this dialog to change nothing.
